note: One county's list: Sarpy County's polling places for November 3, 2026, each with the county's own point, and under by_county the county's own precincts (as renumbered in 2021) with the place each votes at. The map's precinct lines are the ones reported to the Census Bureau in 2020, so no map precinct is tied to a place. The layer has two address columns, which disagree in 20 of 81 rows; the one given here is the layer's FULLADD. Nebraska's other 92 counties publish their own lists; none is read here. Nothing here is shown until a person has compared it with the Sarpy County Election Commission's own list.
